guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: Metrics show a 12000% latency spike and elevated CPU/memory in recommendationservice, while traces indicate frontendservice errors are timeouts waiting for it. The retrieved runbook explicitly links the degradation to conntrack exhaustion dropping connections, confirming socket/connection limits as the root cause.

proposed_fix.description: Increase the node conntrack limit and implement connection pooling in recommendationservice to prevent socket exhaustion and reduce latency.
